A quick, tasty weeknight dinner is one‑pan lemon‑garlic chicken with roasted vegetables.  
**Ingredients (serves 2):** 2 boneless chicken thighs, 1 lb baby potatoes halved, 1 cup broccoli florets, 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic minced, zest & juice of 1 lemon, ½ tsp dried oregano, salt & pepper.  
**Method:** Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes, broccoli, oil, garlic, lemon zest, oregano, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan; spread in a single layer. Nestle chicken thighs among the veggies, drizzle lemon juice over everything. Roast 25‑30 min, until chicken reaches 165°F and veggies are golden. Serve immediately.

PLAN: No further actions required.
